title: Second side of the product graph under proper ambient change
statement: Fix schemes $X,Y$, $f:X\to Y$, a compactification $c$, presentations $s,t$ [def-pur-etale-graph-presentation-maps], and a finite commutative ring $A$. Suppose $pr:P_t\to P_s$ is proper and $q:U_t\to U_s$ makes the open square Cartesian, $a_tq=a_s$, and $pr p_s=p_t$. Let $D_2$ be the second-neighborhood transport and $L$ the endpoint transport of [def-pur-etale-graph-proper-ambient-data]. The second graph-side maps of [lem-sf-etale-locally-closed-graph-model] satisfy $B_{2,s}D_2=L B_{2,t}$. Neither the first side nor the intersection word appears in this assertion.

source.place: Tags 0F7C (lemma-shriek-proper-and-open-compose) and 0F7D (lemma-shriek-proper-and-open-compose-horizontal); applied to the explicit product-graph formula.

proof.text: Use the explicit product and neighborhood maps, their Cartesian squares, and their graph and projection equations.

Apply the transport composition law twice: first to the old second-side square followed by the second-neighborhood square, then to the supplied ambient square followed by the new second-side square. Both rectangles have identical product and neighborhood projections by the explicit pullback-lift equations. Proof irrelevance identifies the Cartesian-square and factorization witnesses, so the two resulting transports are equal.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleGraphProperAmbientSecondSide
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (c : Compactification f)
    (s t : EtaleGraphPresentation f) (pr : t.P ⟶ s.P) [IsProper pr]
    (q : t.U ⟶ s.U) (sq : IsPullback q t.e s.e pr)
    (hz : t.a ≫ q = s.a) (hp : pr ≫ s.p = t.p) :
    (locallyClosedGraphSide₂ s.a s.e s.p c.i c.g
      ((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans (s.fac.trans c.comm)) A).hom ≫
        (s.properAmbientSecondTransport c t pr q sq hz hp A).hom =
      (etaleProperAmbientTransport A s.a s.e s.p t.a t.e t.p pr q sq hz hp).hom ≫
        (locallyClosedGraphSide₂ t.a t.e t.p c.i c.g
      ((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans (t.fac.trans c.comm)) A).hom
